/privacy-policy/: Privacy notice — updated 25 September 2026

This notice explains how Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village handles website enquiries, consultation requests, patient information, recruitment and optional communications. It also applies to visitors outside India.
Who to contact

The website operator is Kairali Ayurvedic Health Resort Pvt. Ltd. The hospital is at III/73 Palayamkadu, P.O. Olassery, Kodumbu, Palakkad District – 678551, Kerala, India. For privacy questions or requests, email info@kairali.com or call +91 9555 156 156. Recruitment requests go to career@kairali.com.
Information and purposes

We use contact details, country, language preferences and enquiry information to respond, arrange consultations and coordinate proposed admission. Information you choose to share may include medical history, medicines, symptoms and reports. Payment and transaction references support invoicing, reconciliation and refunds. CVs and recruitment correspondence are used to assess applications. Website security and cookie-preference information support safe operation and your choices.

Please share only information relevant to your request. Medical reports may be provided through an available upload facility or by email to info@kairali.com, according to your preference. Reports and pre-admission clearance are required only for severe conditions, case by case; the team will tell you what is needed. Do not send card numbers, security codes, PINs or one-time passwords in enquiry forms, email or chat.
Medical information and access

Medical information is used for enquiry assessment and care coordination. Access is restricted by role and need: doctors, designated patient-care staff and sales staff involved in your enquiry. Recruitment records are for authorized HR staff and people involved in hiring, not the medical-report sales team. Necessary technical administration may require authorized IT support.

An enquiry or medical report is not permission for newsletter enrolment or health-based advertising. Where consent is required, it must be requested separately and clearly. Clinical assessment, treatment consent and consent for optional marketing are different decisions.
Reasons for processing and your choices

Depending on the activity and applicable law, processing may be necessary to respond to your request or enter into a contract, deliver agreed services, meet legal obligations, protect vital interests, or pursue legitimate interests such as security and fraud prevention. Where we rely on consent, you may withdraw it. Health information requires an additional legal condition where special-category rules apply; ordinary website use or acceptance of cookies is not consent to every use of medical data.
Newsletter and promotional communications require a separate choice. You may unsubscribe or email info@kairali.com. Withdrawing optional marketing consent does not affect care enquiries.
Service providers and payments

Providers involved in hosting, communications, storage, technical support and payment processing may receive information necessary for their roles. The confirmed payment providers are Razorpay and PayPal. Their payment, identity, fraud-prevention and legal-retention practices are described in their own privacy notices: https://razorpay.com/buyer-privacy-notice/ and https://www.paypal.com/in/legalhub/paypal/privacy-full . A payment provider may retain transaction information; payment processing does not mean that no data is stored.
We may disclose necessary information where required by law or to handle legal claims. Medical reports and enquiry text must not be used as advertising audience data.
Enquiry-report retention

Our approved retention rule for enquiry-only medical reports is deletion within 90 days after the last meaningful patient contact, or sooner when no longer needed. Staff reminders alone do not restart that period. This rule does not cover records created by an actual clinical consultation, OPD care or admission; those follow the hospital’s separate clinical-record requirements. A documented legal obligation or dispute hold may also require restricted retention.

Request earlier deletion at info@kairali.com. Our operational target is 30 days, subject to applicable legal deadlines, proportionate identity checks and explained retention exceptions. Deletion must cover controlled copies and provider-held copies. Restricted backup copies expire through the applicable backup cycle; this is not a promise of immediate deletion from every backup.
Career applications

CVs and application details are used for recruitment. Unsuccessful or withdrawn applications are normally deleted within six months of closure, or sooner when no longer needed, unless a documented retention obligation applies. Keeping an application for future roles requires separate optional permission, for up to 12 months from that permission. Refusal does not affect the current application. Necessary successful-applicant records follow the employee-record schedule.

For access, correction, deletion or withdrawal of future-role permission, email career@kairali.com. The operational deletion target is 30 days, subject to applicable legal deadlines and explained exceptions.
International visitors and processing in India

The hospital operates in India. Information sent for enquiries or care is received and used in India, and service providers may process information in other countries. Data protection rules may differ from those in your home country. Where a regulated international transfer occurs, the appropriate legal transfer mechanism and safeguards must be established; this notice is not a transfer agreement or a blanket waiver of your rights.

For visitors in the EEA or UK, GDPR or UK data-protection rules may apply depending on the activity. Japanese APPI and United States state or federal privacy rules may also apply where their conditions are met. Contact info@kairali.com for information about processing locations, recipients and safeguards relevant to your request.
Your rights and complaints

Depending on applicable law, you may have rights to request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection or portability, to withdraw consent, or to opt out of certain sale, sharing or targeted-advertising activities. Rights and exceptions depend on the processing and law; they are not all rights created by India’s DPDP Act. Contact info@kairali.com, or career@kairali.com for applications.

We may ask for information reasonably needed to verify a request. We will explain any lawful limitation and applicable response period. You may also complain to the competent privacy regulator, including your local EEA supervisory authority, the UK ICO, Japan’s Personal Information Protection Commission, or an applicable US state authority.
Cookies, external services and Priya

See /cookie-policy/ for cookie choices. Priya provides automated assistance with general questions and coordination; it is not a substitute for a physician’s diagnosis or treatment advice. For detailed medical reports, use the hospital’s designated submission channels. External chat, WhatsApp, maps, videos and payment services have their own privacy practices.
Security and changes

Security requires appropriate technical and organizational safeguards and role-based access. No website or storage system can guarantee absolute security. Security incidents must be assessed and notified to affected people and authorities where required, within the applicable legal deadlines.
Updates will be posted with the revision date. A policy change does not retrospectively authorize a new, incompatible use of information or replace consent where it is required.

/cookie-policy/: Cookies and similar browser storage can support security, remember choices and, when enabled with the required permission, measure website use. Simply visiting or continuing to browse is not consent to optional cookies.

Use Accept or Decline on the cookie notice. Declining optional measurement must not prevent reading programme information or contacting the hospital. Use the Cookie choices control on this page to withdraw the saved choice and reload with optional consent denied. You can also manage stored cookies in your browser.

The website saves cookie preferences in browser local storage, including ktahv-consent and kairali-consent-v1. Security or session features may use necessary storage. Browser settings can affect these features.

When production measurement is enabled, the site contains integrations for Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity and Meta. Optional scripts must respect the consent choice. Acceptance is not permission to send medical reports, enquiry text, identifiers or typed health searches to advertising or analytics services. Health-based personalized advertising requires separate assessment and is restricted by advertising-platform rules.

Opening WhatsApp, Priya chat, a payment service, a map or video may connect you to a third party. Its privacy and cookie rules apply to its service. Not every third-party storage item is controlled by the hospital’s cookie banner.
For cookie or privacy questions, email info@kairali.com. See /privacy-policy/ for information about medical reports, retention and your rights.
/payment-policy-compliance/: The confirmed payment providers for AHV patient payments are Razorpay and PayPal. Use only payment instructions issued by the hospital for your enquiry or admission.

The methods and currencies actually offered depend on the payment link or checkout, the enabled merchant-account features, your country and your bank. Razorpay international methods require account activation. PayPal India supports international receipts, not domestic payments from Indian customers. No particular country, card, local method or currency is guaranteed merely because a provider supports it in general.

For patients in Europe, the Americas, Japan or elsewhere, ask the team to confirm a suitable payment route if the offered checkout does not work. Additional issuer authentication, including 3-D Secure where required, may be requested. Do not repeatedly pay after an uncertain result; ask the team to check the transaction reference.

Check the written quotation and the final amount and currency before authorizing payment. The display language does not determine which payment methods are available. Your bank or provider may apply exchange rates or cross-border charges. Ask for clarification of any difference before paying.

Payment authorization and confirmation of admission are separate steps. Keep the transaction reference and the hospital’s written confirmation. Cancellation eligibility follows the applicable approved tariff and written terms; see /cancellation-and-refund-policy/ and contact info@kairali.com if documents conflict.

After a refund is approved and initiated, the bank or payment provider controls when it appears in your account. The team can provide the refund reference and status. Do not treat a processing estimate as a guaranteed credit date. Refunds must follow the provider’s supported process and applicable legal requirements.

Enter payment credentials only in the authorized payment-provider flow. Do not email or message card numbers, CVV/security codes, PINs or one-time passwords. The hospital and payment providers may retain transaction references, amounts, status and records needed for accounting, refunds, security or law.

Using a payment gateway does not remove the merchant’s own security obligations. Provider notices: https://razorpay.com/buyer-privacy-notice/ and https://www.paypal.com/in/legalhub/paypal/privacy-full .
For payment questions or an unrecognized request, contact info@kairali.com or +91 9555 156 156 before paying.
/disclaimer/: Website content provides general information about Ayurveda and the hospital’s services. It does not diagnose your condition or replace an individual consultation. Qualified physicians assess suitability and discuss proposed treatment, expected benefits, risks and alternatives.

Do not stop or change prescribed medicines without the guidance of your treating clinicians. Share relevant diagnoses, medicines and allergies. Individual outcomes vary; no specific improvement or cure is guaranteed.

You may speak with Priya or the sales team, share details for physician review, or request a free video, phone or email consultation. A coordinator arranges the consultation after submission. Priya’s automated responses are not medical diagnosis. For urgent medical needs, contact local emergency services rather than waiting for a website reply.

This notice does not exclude responsibility for negligence, fraud or any liability or patient/consumer right that cannot lawfully be excluded. Website information may change, but changes do not automatically alter agreed admission terms or legal rights.
External services have their own terms. Ask the team about availability and arrangements relevant to you. Contact info@kairali.com or +91 9555 156 156.
/legal-notice/: Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village. Operator: Kairali Ayurvedic Health Resort Pvt. Ltd. Hospital: III/73 Palayamkadu, P.O. Olassery, Kodumbu, Palakkad District – 678551, Kerala, India. Email info@kairali.com; phone +91 9555 156 156. Updated 25 September 2026.
The hospital provides physician-led Ayurvedic care in India. See /accreditations/ for published accreditation information. Website information does not replace an individual medical assessment.

People outside India may use the website to enquire about services. Access to a website does not establish that a treatment, remote consultation or payment method is authorized or available in every jurisdiction. Suitability, applicable requirements and arrangements are confirmed individually.

Indian law governs the hospital’s operations, subject to mandatory rights and rules that apply to the particular patient or transaction. Nothing in this notice removes a right to complain to a competent regulator or use a court where mandatory law permits.
